scope: Previously seen regression clip, not an unseen holdout.
review_protocol: Assistant inspected all 204 full-scene annotated frames in 13 contact sheets. All 47 causal confirmations were visible; F59-74 follow the black-shirt distractor. Selected crop audit covers F59 and F70-74. No independent human labels.
no_protection_caution: Pink target remains identifiable in all selected boxes; overlapping boxes may contain another person. Identity labels do not certify segmentation, complete body geometry or joint accuracy.

wrong_recovery.cause: The true pink target remains a provisional microtrack but geometric clues reset its clear anchor window. At F59 the recovery optimization has only one eligible identity and one eligible black-person candidate. Its margin compares this wrong edge with two unmatched dummies, not with the excluded true target. Raw candidate retention did not guarantee competitor retention in recovery.
wrong_recovery.gallery_contamination: Code permits clean confirmed observations to update the gallery. The wrong F59-70 observations are clean, so their features enter the target gallery; later low coverage cannot be attributed solely to the original freeze.

offline_result.cause: The first-frame seed has a geometric overlap clue. Reliable fragments are created only on clean frames, so no retained fragment has contains_explicit_seed=true. The target path is empty. This is an implementation failure, not evidence that two-endpoint linking is impossible.

prior_v3: 9 confirmed first frames, same selected detections as the reviewed pink target; 195 missing. Causal retains all 9 but introduces 16 wrong-person accepts.

single_person_regression_review.findings: The visible person remains correctly enclosed by the prior box at these frames. The new gaps are real coverage regressions, not a disappearing subject. Slow overhead/single-leg selections match prior detection indices for every frame. Ballet A causal also retains all prior detections.
single_person_regression_review.limit: No independent full-frame identity or joint labels for the five single-person clips; visual spot checks plus exhaustive index/state comparison and all lost-frame review.

decision: FAIL integration gate. Preserve all attempts. No shared 3D inference or baseline replacement. No threshold sweep or new encoder.
